Explain Shizuku permission and restart setup
Why Shizuku?

Shizuku gives this app access to Android shell commands that change NXTPAPER display modes. It needs your permission and does not require root.\n\nEmergency Stop waits five minutes, or until the commitment ends if sooner. Protection stays active during the wait. If Shizuku stops or loses permission, protection is unavailable until it reconnects.
Restart help
Restarting and Wi-Fi

After a restart: Shizuku 13.6+ on Android 13+ can start automatically over trusted Wi-Fi. Enable Wireless debugging in Developer settings and Start on boot in Shizuku. Pair if asked; usually once.

New Wi-Fi? Android may ask for permission again. Choose “Always allow” only for a network you trust.

No Wi-Fi? An already running guard works offline. After a restart, use USB and a computer to start Shizuku; follow Shizuku → View command or run START_SHIZUKU_USB.cmd. Mobile data alone cannot start wireless debugging.

Explain how the physical switch is detected
The physical switch

Move the side switch to Max Ink to start the selected commitment. If it is already in Ink, move it to Normal, then Max Ink.

During a commitment, the screen returns to Max Ink if you move the switch to Normal early. This can take around 20 seconds.

If the switch does not respond, remove any magnetic case or holder and try again.

Explain the commitment and continued reading
Choose once, then read

Choose a duration, then move the physical switch to Max Ink. Your %1$s commitment starts when Max Ink is ready.

An early move to Normal brings Max Ink back without restarting the timer. After the timer, keep reading or move to Normal when ready.

Emergency Stop starts a five-minute wait while protection continues. If your commitment ends sooner, stopping begins then. Continue commitment cancels the exit request and keeps your original timer. When stopping finishes, the next session returns to five minutes.

This is an experimental test and does not create a commitment. Software transitions are bounded to 45 seconds. Keep the phone unlocked and remove magnetic cases or holders.

Recovery: move the physical slider to Ink, then back to Normal and wait for the native transition. If access is lost, use the native controls and restart Shizuku.

The app may close when Max Ink starts. Reopen it to follow the saved test progress. Cancel test attempts restoration immediately, without the five-minute Stop delay.
